instruction: A cinematic film still, captured in a medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. The scene is set in a cozy indoor room with curtains and a houseplant in the background. The blonde woman in a white shirt (R2) stands on the left with her back to the camera, embracing the elderly man in a striped shirt (R1) who stands on the right facing left. They are locked in a warm hug; the blonde woman wraps her arms around the elderly man's shoulders, while the elderly man holds her close with his hands resting on her back, his eyes closed in a peaceful expression. The scene is illuminated by soft, warm indoor lighting, creating a gentle and intimate atmosphere.
